newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares stay subdued, prices lower.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares stay subdued, prices lower.

text.p: Latvian shares were still stuck in the summer doldrums on Tuesday as activity edged slightly higher and prices were stable to lower, dealers said.
Total turnover edged up to 78,000 lats from 76,000 lats. The bourse index lost 2.67 points to 385.05 while the Rietumu Bank index slipped 0.96 percent to 150.96.
"I would say that trade at the moment is just trickling slowly along," said one trader.
Dealers said the market was staying sluggish given a lack of new factors and did not expect a pick up until after the summer lull ended.
Unibanka led in terms of activity, trading 41,700 lats and losing three santimes to 3.30 lats.
Other shares were far behind it in turnover terms, with fellow official list stock Daugavpils Chain the second busiest on 11,000 lats but staying unchanged at 1.07 lats.
Valmiera Glassfibre lost one santime as it edged down to 1.36 lats on turnover of 9,100 lats.
Kaija lost six santimes to 2.10 lats on trade of 4,300 lats.
